title: When someone falls behind
sub: Film 3 of Ownership and performance, in Leading data people: when one person's work falls behind the team's. Find the cause before you judge: training, fit for the role, or a hard time. Clear what's in the way, measure the gap against the team's own change, and give it time.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (Tomás's own plan), orange is data (the days from a request to first use), green is something done or a blocker cleared, and amber a risk or a gap (the gap between his work and the team's).
